title: Child at Hildebran Church Steps, 1951 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white vintage snapshot featuring a small child standing on the concrete steps of a simple white rural church building. The bright sunlight creates heavy contrast and overexposure on the facade. The handwritten inscription on the reverse notes 'Hildebran field - my first church 1951, 1952', capturing a quiet moment from mid-century American community life.
